exercise.title: Find the smooth spot
exercise.why: In tune with the drone sounds smooth and off sounds like a wobble, so the drone lets you check yourself with no one listening.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together. Your pitch shows as a line on the staff.
Sing the low {{1}} on "oo" and slide a little above and below it until the wobble stops. Hold the smooth spot for as long as feels easy.
_Don't reach for high notes: the low {{1}} is the only note this drill needs._
